将简短的提示变成详细的图像

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 写下提示。一行字的想法就足够了，就像“一栋被藤蔓覆盖的废弃维多利亚式宅邸，油画风格”。增强器填充灯光、情绪和构图。适用于：海报·信息图表·概念艺术·插图

步骤 2. 选择打开或关闭增强器。让它保持打开状态，让简短的提示完成更多工作。当您希望用准确的措辞来驱动图像时，请将其关闭。

步骤 3. 点击运行并下载。你会得到一个 1024px 的图像。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。适用于：Photoshop · Figma · Canva · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（1024 x 1024 · 20 步 · CFG 4 · 增强器打开）对于几乎每个人来说都是正确的起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 ERNIE Image（百度的开放权重模型）根据文本提示生成图像。它运行两种模型，而不是一种。一个小型提示增强器将您的输入重写为更长的结构化视觉描述，然后 8B 图像模型对其进行渲染。因此，一行想法会以详细图像的形式返回，而无需您编写段落。增强器还会读取您的宽度和高度，因此它会调整其描述以匹配您的宽高比。 ERNIE Image 非常擅长清晰的图像内文本，这使得它非常适合海报、标牌和布局工作，在这些工作中，大多数图像模型都会产生乱码。您输入提示，点击运行，大约 37 秒后即可恢复图像。无需设置，无需节点 金属丝。

适用对象：想要详细图像而不需要编写长提示的创建者，以及需要图像内可读文本的任何人。 Not for: image editing or character consistency across shots.为此，请使用 Qwen Image Edit 或 FLUX.2 Klein 工作流程。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 输入您的提示。保持简短并让增强器扩展它，或者关闭增强器并完整地写入它。

  2. 如果需要，可以添加否定提示，然后使用默认值运行（1024 x 1024，20 个步骤，CFG 4）。

  3. 从运行中下载图像，为任何编辑器做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每张图像大约在 37 秒内返回。需要知道的一个权衡是：打开增强器后，您可以获得更多细节，但对措辞的控制更少，因此当确切的措辞很重要时将其关闭。修复种子以比较相同成分的即时变化，并将 CFG 保持在 4 附近，因为将其推至 6 及以上可能会导致烧伤和颜色伪影。 ERNIE Image is Apache 2.0 licensed, so both the model and your images are yours to use commercially.

使用案例

海报和文字为主的设计。为海报、标牌、信息图表和广告框架生成带有可读图像内文本的图像。

概念艺术和情绪板。输入一个粗略的想法并获得完整描述的图像，这对于您在知道自己想要什么之前进行早期探索非常有用。

插图和场景。 Produce general scenes and illustrations across photoreal, design, and stylized looks.

快速构思。修复种子，更改一行，并比较同一构图的提示变化。

ERNIE Image 可以生成什么？

o.en:
Turn a short prompt into a detailed image

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Write your prompt. A one-line idea is enough, like "an abandoned Victorian mansion overtaken by vines, oil painting style." The enhancer fills in the lighting, mood, and composition. Works great with: posters · infographics · concept art · illustrations

Step 2. Choose enhancer on or off. Leave it on to let short prompts do more work. Turn it off when you want your exact wording to drive the image.

Step 3. Hit run and download. You get back a 1024px image. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Photoshop · Figma · Canva · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (1024 x 1024 · 20 steps · CFG 4 · enhancer on) are the right starting point for almost everyone.

Overview

This workflow generates an image from a text prompt using ERNIE Image, an open-weight model from Baidu. It runs two models, not one. A small prompt enhancer rewrites your input into a longer, structured visual description, then the 8B image model renders it. So a one-line idea comes back as a detailed image without you writing a paragraph. The enhancer also reads your width and height, so it shapes its description to match your aspect ratio. ERNIE Image is unusually good at legible in-image text, which makes it a fit for posters, signage, and layout work where most image models produce garbled lettering. You type a prompt, hit run, and get the image back in about 37 seconds. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators who want detailed images without writing long prompts, and anyone who needs readable text inside the image. Not for: image editing or character consistency across shots. Use a Qwen Image Edit or FLUX.2 Klein workflow for those.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Type your prompt. Keep it short and let the enhancer expand it, or turn the enhancer off and write it in full.

  2. Add a negative prompt if you want, then run with the defaults (1024 x 1024, 20 steps, CFG 4).

  3. Download the image from the run, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each image comes back in about 37 seconds. One tradeoff to know: with the enhancer on you get more detail but less control over phrasing, so switch it off when the exact wording matters. Fix the seed to compare prompt variations on the same composition, and keep CFG near 4, since pushing it to 6 and above can cause burn and color artifacts. ERNIE Image is Apache 2.0 licensed, so both the model and your images are yours to use commercially.

Use Cases

Posters & Text-Heavy Design. Generate images with readable in-image text for posters, signage, infographics, and ad frames.

Concept Art & Mood Boards. Type a rough idea and get a fully described image, useful for early exploration before you know what you want.

Illustrations & Scenes. Produce general scenes and illustrations across photoreal, design, and stylized looks.

Fast Ideation. Fix a seed, change one line, and compare prompt variations on the same composition.
